does: Adds to an AI score the worth of a position for a character under the given PositionScoreOptions: AI hint triggers, invisibility, statuses and items near the position, written to the AI score log.

evidence.says: the position-scoring log line about a nearby item; takes character, position and PositionScoreOptions and fills the AiScore it is given
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 1 place, CalculatePositionScore (about 15 000 calls)

takes esv::Character, a position and esv::PositionScoreOptions and fills an esv::AiScore; calls esv::AiHelpers::CheckAiHintTrigger, reads eoc::InvisibilityComponent, BoundComponent and esv::Item, the log line about a nearby item
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the text constants both refer to
